Draw a key as a box diagram

Source: R/diagram.R
keyDiagram.Rd

Draws a dimoose key top-down as an SVG picture, the way keys are often drawn on paper: each couplet is a blue box holding its question, its leads are blue boxes below it, and every lead either continues to the next couplet or ends in a green box naming the result. A result written as "Common name (Genus species)" is drawn on two lines with the scientific name in italics.

Usage

keyDiagram(key, file = NULL, images = TRUE, title = NULL)

Arguments

key

A dimoose key.

file

Optional path of an .svg file to write.

images

If TRUE, show a thumbnail in a result's box when the terminal lead names an image (Image column) that is embedded in the key's meta (see imageMeta()).

title

Heading drawn above the tree; by default the key's desc. Use NA for none.

Value

The SVG as a single string, invisibly when file is given.

Details

A couplet reached from more than one lead is drawn once, under the first of them; the other leads get a dashed line to it.

See also

exportWizard() for an interactive version of the key.

Examples

keyDiagram(arachnidaKey(), tempfile(fileext = ".svg"))
